lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the branchial region. The spots are arranged in roughly horizontal rows, with higher density and larger diameters observed in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are discernible, intersecting horizontal rows of spots to form a lattice-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity surface reflection to a darker shadowed region immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible surface of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated towards the leading edge and middle sections of the fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: At least three elongated, dark-pigmented organisms (remoras) are visible attached to the ventral area just posterior to the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
